title: When and how is preregistration in experimental biology worth the effort?
content:
by Olavo B. Amaral, Clarissa F. D. Carneiro, Bruna Valério-Gomes, Kleber Neves, Mariana B. Abreu

Preregistration can improve the credibility of published research, but its uptake in the life sciences remains low. What is hampering its adoption in experimental biology, and can the format be adapted to better suit the needs of researchers?
